heldout_limit_rule: For each arm: ceil(max(120, 2 * (stage_wall + 20 * max_request_wall))) seconds, rounded up to 30 seconds. CPU analog uses floor 240 and rounding 60. Reject proposal above 600 wall or 1200 CPU per arm. Cumulative wall/CPU equals all charged rehearsal work plus sum of four proposed arm caps. Never subtract sleep.
dataset_policy: Intentionally carry forward the unchanged v1 development and never-evaluated heldout datasets; no new templates, labels, scorer, model, selector or generation settings. V1 copies are declared identity overlap, not independent replication.
success_criteria: Carry forward every v1 conjunctive numerical quality, regression, unsupported/stale and >=10% complete CPU AND wall gate; report lexical comparison first.
cost_policy: Primary: this arm's rehearsal including replay, heldout cold stage and every failed/partial attempt; TORUK also pays historical training/profile once over N=28. No new training. Also report warm requests and a separate all-history sunk-cost ledger for v1; incomplete v1 CPU remains unknown, so no all-history efficiency claim. Shared preparation/checking overhead disclosed separately and allocated equally across arms in a secondary total. No timing subtraction or hidden retry.
